signal.title: SCMTIPS Signal (scmtips.exchange/v1)
signal.description: A market or disruption event from the intelligence feed. It enters as an article from the named source, so the matching ladder and the relevance gate apply as for any news.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

external_id.description: The feed's id for the event.

url.description: Link to the source article, if any.

countries.description: ISO country codes, separated by semicolons.

supplier_codes.description: SCMTIPS supplier codes, if the feed knows them.

supplier_names.description: Supplier names as written in the source.

item_codes.description: SCMTIPS item or material codes affected.

rows.title: Export licences tightened for rare-earth magnets
rows.summary: New licence checks on NdFeB magnet exports from 10 November.

planning_request.title: SCMTIPS Planning request (scmtips.exchange/v1)
planning_request.description: The constraints a decision puts on supply, per item, site and month, sent to the planning system to re-balance and return options.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row answers.

unit_cost_delta.description: Change in unit cost, in currency.

planning_result.title: SCMTIPS Planning result (scmtips.exchange/v1)
planning_result.description: The options the planning system proposes for a planning request: one row per option, item, site and month. The option totals repeat on each of the option's rows.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row answers.

version_id.description: The plan version the option comes from.

option_cost.description: The option's total cost, in currency.

published_at.description: Date and time, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z

decision_outcome.title: SCMTIPS Decision outcome (scmtips.exchange/v1)
decision_outcome.description: What was decided, by which role, with which proof: exported for the record. Never imported: an approval read from a file would skip the step-up and the audit chain.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row answers.

approver_roles.description: Roles that approved; never personal names.

step_up.description: Whether the approval passed a step-up check.

decided_at.description: Date and time, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z

committed_at.description: Date and time, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z

audit_entry_hash.description: Hash of the audit-chain entry that records the outcome.

work_order.title: SCMTIPS Work order (scmtips.exchange/v1)
work_order.description: One row per line of the execution orders an approved decision releases: production, purchase and transfer orders, checked against resource availability.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row answers.

previous.description: JSON of the values before the change.

progress.title: SCMTIPS Progress (scmtips.exchange/v1)
progress.description: Status of a released order from the PMO tool or the shop floor. Statuses only move forward: acknowledged, started, completed (or failed).

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

event_id.description: The sender's unique id for this event; a repeat changes nothing.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row belongs to.

occurred_at.description: Date and time, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z

task_ref.description: The PMO tool's own task id.

erp_extract.title: SCMTIPS ERP extract (scmtips.exchange/v1)
erp_extract.description: Stock, open purchase and work orders, and the bill of materials, exactly as the data import takes them (one sheet each). Live, the ERP feeds them to the data feeds.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

goods_receipt.title: SCMTIPS Goods receipt (scmtips.exchange/v1)
goods_receipt.description: Parts received against a purchase order, posted by the ERP after the warehouse captures them. It becomes one stock row and one PO row of the ERP extract.

message_id.description: Idempotency key: a repeated id changes nothing.

correlation_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision id, for the audit trail.

source_system.description: The sending system, e.g. naradcue, sangamiq, erp.

event_id.description: The sender's unique id for this event; a repeat changes nothing.

decision_id.description: The SCMTIPS decision this row belongs to.

on_hand_after_qty.description: The ERP's on-hand after the receipt (absolute, not the change).

received_at.description: Date and time, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z

evidence_ref.description: The capture's id in the Field app.
